AuthzTenantAdminBindingView.description: One role binding: an account holds a role within a tenant.

account.description: The account the role is bound to.

granted_at.description: When the binding was written, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

role.description: The role bound to the account.

tenant.description: The tenant the binding belongs to.

AuthzTenantAdminGrantView.description: One permission grant of a role: the permission it was written as, and the (resource, action) pair the policy engine matches on.

action.description: The action the grant matches on, kept beside the permission so an untranslatable grant can still be diagnosed.

created_at.description: When the grant was written, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

permission.description: The permission the (resource, action) pair translates to, for example authz.tenant.role.manage; the empty string when the pair matches no declared permission, which is a grant left from a vocabulary this process no longer carries.

resource.description: The resource the grant matches on, kept beside the permission so an untranslatable grant can still be diagnosed.

tenant.description: The tenant the grant belongs to.

AuthzTenantAdminPermissionView.description: One permission of the tenant-governed set.

description.description: The permission's description, rendered in the request's language from the key the declaring module gave it. Empty when the assembly delivers no message localizer or the module gave the permission no description key. A key no catalog carries comes back as the key itself, the i18n fallback.

permission.description: The permission name as the catalog declares it, for example authz.tenant.role.read. Only the authn.* permissions are the same vocabulary as authn.Action and carry its string.

AuthzTenantAdminRoleView.description: One role of a tenant as the role routes report it.

builtin.description: True for a builtin role: the tenant management face can neither rewrite nor remove it, nor change its grants. The mark is set by the host that seeds the policy data and is never cleared.

created_at.description: When the role was written, as an RFC 3339 instant in UTC.

description_key.description: The i18n key of the role's description text; stored as given and not resolved by this surface.

role.description: The role name within the tenant.

tenant.description: The tenant the role belongs to.

AuthzTenantAdminRoleWrite.description: The body of a role write: the role's description key only. The builtin mark is not part of the body; a member sent under that name reaches nothing.

description_key.description: The i18n key of the role's description text. It is stored as given and not resolved by this surface.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem document. This is the entry point's default error shape, which a host-supplied ErrorResponder may replace.

detail.description: A longer explanation of this occurrence, present only when the answering module has one to give. It may be a sentence rendered in the request language or a language-neutral token such as "forbidden", so clients must not parse it.

instance.description: A URI identifying this occurrence; absent when there is none to give.

status.description: The HTTP status code the response is written with, repeated from the status line.

title.description: A short summary of the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the standard English status text for the status code.

type.description: The machine-readable code identifying the kind of problem. A module that sets none gets the RFC 9457 default about:blank; codes this platform defines are URNs of the form urn:speed:<capability>:<code>.

delete.description: Removes the account's binding to the role within the tenant. An empty account is refused with a 400. platform-admin is reserved and cannot be removed here. A caller may not remove its own tenant-admin binding: that is refused with the protected code, and another tenant administrator removes it. The last tenant administrator of the tenant cannot be removed. A mandatory audit row is written before the action; if it cannot be written the action is not carried out and the answer is 503.

400.description: The account or the tenant is empty

409.description: The binding is the last tenant administrator of the tenant

delete.summary: Remove an account's binding to a role within a tenant

put.description: Binds a role to an account within the tenant. The account must be an active member of the tenant, and the caller's own permissions must cover every permission the role holds. An empty account is refused with a 400. platform-admin is reserved and cannot be bound here; tenant-admin may be bound to another account, subject to the same subset rule. A mandatory audit row is written before the action; if it cannot be written the action is not carried out and the answer is 503.
